title: 第 21 章你究竟用了什么妖术第22章 真是奇耻大辱啊
slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: “听到了没有？给我滚出来。”
院门外传来一阵叫骂声，声音很大整个院子都能听得清清楚楚。
正在屋里休息的陈默听到这个声音之后眉头皱了一下，他心想这又是谁来找自己的麻烦。
“陈默你聋了是不是，我让你滚出来没听到吗。”
外面的声音越来越大了而且语气也很冲，陈默站起身推开门走了出去。
院子里站着一个身穿白色长袍的年轻男子，面容俊朗但此刻脸上的表情却格外阴沉。
而陈默并不认识这个人不过看对方的穿着应该是内门弟子。
“你是谁。”陈默淡淡道。
“周牧之。”
当陈默听到这个名字之后想了一下，他在心里想着没听过这个人的名字，“有事？”
“当然有事不然谁愿意来你这个破地方，我听说你擅闯藏经阁二楼，还跟苏婉清动了手可有这回事。”
此时陈默看着他脸上没有什么表情，他心想原来是替苏婉清出头的。
“是又怎样。”
而周牧之听到这句话之后脸色变得更加难看了，他没想到一个外门弟子敢用这种语气跟他说话。
“你一个外门弟子擅闯藏经阁二楼，还敢对苏师妹动手你知道你犯了什么罪吗。”
“不知道也没兴趣。”
“你……”周牧之被噎了一下眼中闪过一丝怒意，“我现在给你一个机会，你现在跟我去给苏师妹赔罪然后跪下来磕三个头这件事我可以不追究。”
然而陈默听到这话之后忍不住笑了一下，他在心里想着这个人是不是脑子有问题。
“让我去给她赔罪还要跪下来磕头？”
“没错，你要是肯乖乖照做我还可以帮你说几句好话让苏师妹饶你一次。”
“要是不肯呢。”
“你要是不肯那就别怪我不客气了，到时候就不是赔罪这么简单了。”
“说完了吗。”
此时周牧之愣了一下也不知道他要说什么。
“说完了就滚吧我没时间陪你在这里废话。”
一听这话周牧之的脸色当场就变了，他的眼中充满了怒火整个人的气势都变得凌厉起来。
没想到一个外门弟子居然敢让他滚，要知道他在内门这么多年还从来没有人敢这么跟他说话。
“陈默你找死。”周牧之怒声道，“你以为你是谁一个外门弟子也敢这么狂妄我看你是活腻了，今天不给你点教训你还真把自己当个人物了。”
于是周牧之抬起手调动体内的真元，一股强大的气势从他身上扩散出来。
元婴期的修为在青云宗已经算是不错了，他觉得自己收拾一个外门弟子简直就是易如反掌。
可就在他准备出手的时候院门外传来一阵脚步声，一个身影抱着一堆草药走了进来。
是周玄。
此时他从外面回来的时候刚好路过这里，听到院子里的动静之后就走了进来。
看到周牧之的时候周玄的脸色变了一下，他心想这不是内门的周师兄吗。
没记错的话周牧之是内门执剑长老门下的大弟子，还是元婴期的修为而且在整个青云宗都是排得上号的人物。
只是不知道他来陈默这里干什么，周玄看了看周牧之又看了看陈默然后心中明白了。
“发生何事了陈默。”周玄开口的同时声音里也带着几分担心。
“没什么一条狗在外面乱叫而已。”陈默淡淡道。
当周牧之听到这句话之后整个人都炸了，他的脸涨得通红眼中的怒火直接爆发了出来。
content_en:
"Did you hear that? Get out of here."
There was a burst of yelling and cursing outside the courtyard gate. The sound was so loud that the entire courtyard could hear it clearly.
Chen Mo, who was resting in the room, frowned when he heard the voice. He thought to himself who was causing trouble for him.
"Chen Mo, are you deaf? Didn't you hear me telling you to get out?"
The sounds outside became louder and louder, and Chen Mo stood up, opened the door and walked out.
Standing in the yard was a young man wearing a white robe, with a handsome face, but the expression on his face was particularly gloomy at the moment.
Chen Mo didn't know this person, but judging from his clothes, he should be an inner disciple.
"Who are you?" Chen Mo said calmly.
"Zhou Muzhi."
When Chen Mo heard the name, he thought for a moment. He thought that he had never heard of this person's name before, "Is something wrong?"
"Of course there is something going on, otherwise who would want to come to this shabby place like yours? I heard that you broke into the second floor of the Sutra Pavilion without permission and even made a move with Su Wanqing."
At this time, Chen Mo looked at him with no expression on his face. He thought to himself that he was standing up for Su Wanqing.
"So what."
After hearing this, Zhou Muzhi's face became even more ugly. He did not expect that an outer disciple would dare to speak to him in such a tone.
"You, an outer disciple, broke into the second floor of the Sutra Pavilion without permission and dared to attack Junior Sister Su. Do you know what crime you committed?"
"I don't know and I'm not interested."
"You..." Zhou Muzhi was choked and a trace of anger flashed in his eyes, "I will give you a chance now. You and I can go to apologize to Junior Sister Su and then kneel down and kowtow three times. I don't have to hold you accountable."
However, Chen Mo couldn't help but laugh after hearing this. He was wondering if this person had a brain problem.
"You want me to apologize to her and kneel down and kowtow?"
"That's right, if you are willing to obey me, I can even say a few nice words to you and ask Junior Sister Su to spare you for once."
"What if you don't want to."
"If you refuse, don't blame me for being rude. Then it won't be as simple as making amends."
"Are you done?"
At this time, Zhou Muzhi was stunned for a moment and didn't know what he was going to say.
"Get out of here when you're done. I don't have time to talk nonsense here with you."
Upon hearing this, Zhou Muzhi's expression changed on the spot, his eyes were filled with anger and his whole aura became fierce.
He didn't expect that an outer sect disciple would dare to tell him to go away. After all his years in the inner sect, no one had ever dared to talk to him like this.
"Chen Mo, you are looking for death." Zhou Muzhi said angrily, "Who do you think you are, an outer disciple? You dare to be so arrogant. I think you are tired of living. If I don't teach you a lesson today, you really think of yourself as a nobody."
So Zhou Muzhi raised his hand to mobilize the true energy in his body, and a powerful momentum spread from his body.
The cultivation level in the Nascent Soul stage was already pretty good in Qingyun Sect. He felt that it would be easy for him to take care of an outer disciple.
But just when he was about to take action, there was a sound of footsteps outside the courtyard door, and a figure walked in holding a pile of herbs.
It's Zhou Xuan.
At this time, he happened to pass by here when he came back from outside, and walked in after hearing the movement in the yard.
When he saw Zhou Muzhi, Zhou Xuan's expression changed. He thought to himself that this was Senior Brother Zhou from the inner sect.
If I remember correctly, Zhou Muzhi was the eldest disciple of the Inner Sect Elder Sword Holder. He was still at the Nascent Soul Stage and was a high-ranking figure in the entire Qingyun Sect.
I just didn't know what he was doing here with Chen Mo. Zhou Xuan looked at Zhou Muzhi and then at Chen Mo and understood in his heart.
"What happened, Chen Mo." Zhou Xuan spoke with a bit of worry in his voice.
"It's just a dog barking outside." Chen Mo said calmly.
When Zhou Muzhi heard this, his whole body exploded. His face turned red and the anger in his eyes burst out.
